I need a script that will crawl a specific website and pull every phone number it can find. I do not need emails or social media links—just the phone numbers exactly as they appear online, kept in their original local format. The script should: • Navigate through all internal pages, following pagination or category links where necessary. • Extract and store each number along with the source URL so I can trace it back if needed. • Remove duplicates automatically. • Run without triggering blocks or throttling (a short configurable delay between requests is fine). Please deliver: 1. A well-commented script (Python is ideal, but any language I can execute on Windows is acceptable). 2. A clean CSV or Excel file containing the final list of local-format numbers and their corresponding page URLs. 3. Simple instructions so I can rerun the scrape in the future. I will verify a random sample of entries against the live site; matches there will confirm completion. Let me know if you need the domain or any additional site details to get started.
